purpose: Research-only per-parameter accounting; original assertions are not a whole-API parity claim.
selection: All DescribeTextFrame unit variants; every text-frame and fit-text BDD example; every layout and font unit variant. Existing whole-package test-case-map.json retains all other obligations.

statusDefinitions.assertions_authored_pending_execution: Original TS cases exist, target checks pending.
statusDefinitions.deferred_metrics_required: Assigned to supplied-metrics tasks, never counted as metadata autofit coverage.
statusDefinitions.public_behavior_gap: Retained public behavior outside configuration; not implemented by this receipt.
statusDefinitions.original_assertions_passed: Matching original parameter or BDD acceptance assertions passed; global ledger is not changed by this local receipt.

intentionalDivergences.hostIO: No font discovery, operating-system font folders, native font library or host path. Explicit admitted metrics replace font_file (J07). Font-table admission cases remain separate portable-codec obligations.
intentionalDivergences.units: J05 Length conversion uses nearest integer, halfway away from zero and finite safe bounds; typed lengths remain exact in EMUs.
intentionalDivergences.enum: J04 enum metadata is immutable; aliases share identity; MIXED is readable metadata but is rejected on XML writes.
intentionalDivergences.null: J01/J05 undefined leaves unchanged; null removes direct formatting. Absent body attributes can have effective format defaults distinct from direct metadata.
intentionalDivergences.fitBoundaries: Fit search includes integer candidates 1 through max_size. Width 49 and 50 fit bound 50; 51 does not. Two lines of height 50 fail height 99 and fit heights 100 and 101. Maximum satisfying value in 0..9 for <6.5 is 6; predicates >9.9 and <0 return none. Preserve line-prefix/remainder ordering and no-fit behavior.
intentionalDivergences.fitBDD: Original supplied-metrics design in retained row chooses exactly 10pt rather than source host-dependent 10pt or 11pt; wrapping=true and autofit=NONE must remain. Metadata settings never resize run fonts.
intentionalDivergences.defaultInsets: Model assigning format-default margins removes the direct inset attribute, matching source behavior; operation JSON supplied margins are explicit metadata. Model getters return default Lengths for absent direct values.

source.identity: Set text size to best-fit point size

expanded_steps.text: Given a text frame with more text than will fit
When I call TextFrame.fit_text()
Then text_frame.auto_size is MSO_AUTO_SIZE.NONE
And text_frame.word_wrap is True
And the size of the text is 10pt or 11pt

expanded_scenario.text: Given a text frame with more text than will fit
When I call TextFrame.fit_text()
Then text_frame.auto_size is MSO_AUTO_SIZE.NONE
And text_frame.word_wrap is True
And the size of the text is 10pt or 11pt

originalDesign.title: Choose the largest fitting size from supplied metrics

arrange.metrics: An explicit admitted deterministic metrics capability: each glyph including space advances s points and every line is s points high at candidate size s. No kerning or fallback. Each five-letter word fits at all candidates up to 18.

originalDesign.act: Call text_frame.fit_text("Harbor Sans", 18, false, false, admittedMetrics).

expected.reason: The 11-glyph string exceeds width at 10pt and wraps into two 50pt words; total height is 20pt. At 11pt the two-line height is 22pt, so 11 and all larger candidates fail.

originalDesign.negative_assertion: The explicit metrics capability is the only font authority; no host font file, discovery, native renderer or external service.

equivalence.rationale: The source allows 10pt or 11pt because of host font differences. J07 replaces that platform-dependent choice with a deterministic 10pt result, while preserving best-fit selection, auto_size NONE and wrapping. Original text/metrics replace the source deck/font. This is a security mapping, not a claim of renderer equivalence.
